name: stability ball single leg squat
description: A single-leg squat with a stability ball between your back and a wall for support, building one-sided leg strength.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Lift one foot and balance on the other leg.
Lower into a squat while the ball rolls down the wall.
Press through your heel to stand back up.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
